card.delete_data: What it added to the Inbox and the knowledge base is deleted too. This can't be undone.
card.delete_keep: What it already added to the Inbox and the knowledge base stays.
card.existing.baseline: What it finds at once is only recorded, not added: only what arrives later comes in.
card.existing.deliver: Everything it finds at once comes in as new, one by one.
card.existing.digest: What it finds at once comes into the Inbox as one digest when there are more than 3, as when the Inbox is turned on.
card.found_one: A dry run just now found {count} item.
card.found_other: A dry run just now found {count} items.
card.label: Name
card.recipe_same: • {what}: still uses "{tool}", reading its results differently
check.interval: Not more often than the source allows
checks.title: Safety checks
confirm.push_to_inbox:
Turn on Add to Inbox?

What {source} sends:
• Kept on your hub as each item comes in
• Added to the Inbox: more than 3 from the day before are combined into one digest, then one row each
• Triaged by the Information filtering model{provider}

Only what a shortcut passes is sent. Nothing reads other apps' notifications.

• Saved to the knowledge base, grouped into conversations you can search
• Summarized by the Information processing model{provider}

Only what a shortcut passes is sent. Nothing reads other apps' notifications.

draft.busy: Another draft is running for this connector. Try again when it's done.
draft.consent:
Draft a recipe with AI?

This source's tool descriptions and a trimmed sample (at most 3 items) go to the Information processing model ({provider}). The sample isn't kept, and every pull after that follows the draft without calling a model.

It can take up to 4 minutes.
draft.no_model: No Information processing model yet: set one up in Settings › Models, or choose a tool yourself
draft.running_line: Up to 4 minutes. You can leave; it shows here when done
draft.start_line: It reads the tools and one sample and writes how to pull; pulls after that call no model
draft.title: Draft with AI
dry.failed: Couldn't run it. Try again in a moment.
dry.maybe_more: Everything on this page is new, so there may be more. A shorter interval would catch it.
dry.shape_json_one: The result is JSON, {count} item on this page.
dry.shape_json_other: The result is JSON, {count} items on this page.
dry.shape_text: The result is text, so it can only be a snapshot.
dry.title: Dry run (just now, not saved)
failed.title: Couldn't read subscriptions
field.title: Title
gone.detail: It may have been deleted on another device.
gone.title: This subscription is gone
line.needs_recipe: The tool changed: fix the recipe
line.not_connected: Source not connected; resumes once it is
list.footer: A failing subscription stays listed here and in a banner at the top of the Inbox. Nothing stops silently.
list.intro: Pull what's new from a connector's read-only tools into the Inbox or the knowledge base on a schedule. Only read-only tools are used: nothing is sent or changed for you.
list.native: Persona already reads this; subscribing would duplicate it
list.none_detail: Connectors with read-only tools show up here.
list.push_add_detail: Send notifications and more to Persona with the Handle Notification action
list.push_footer: Add the Handle Notification action to a shortcut or a personal automation, such as one that runs when a message arrives. The source also appears by itself with the first item.
list.push_hint: An iPhone or iPad can send items here with the Handle Notification action in Shortcuts. Its source appears with the first item.
new.freq_footer: Every 15 minutes by default; you can change it once a destination is on.
new.pick_footer: Pick a read-only tool and try it to check the result, then turn on a destination.
origin.model: Drafted by the Information processing model on {date}.
pick.fallback_footer: When no triage model works, new items go here instead of waiting.
pick.interval_footer: This source allows at most one pull every {span}. Subscriptions on one account take turns, at least 20 seconds apart.
plain.items: Calls {source}'s read-only tool "{tool}" {every} for new {noun} since the last pull (looking back an extra hour so nothing slips through). Each one comes in once.
plain.snapshot: Calls {source}'s read-only tool "{tool}" {every} and keeps a snapshot, only when it changed.
plain.weak_dedup: The result has no ID, so duplicates are caught by content: an edited item comes in again.
problem.annotation: Its maker marks it as changing something
problem.assistant_offline: It's off now, but the assistant is away, so its stored content isn't deleted yet. Try again in a moment
problem.bad_args: The arguments don't match the tool
problem.model_failed: The model couldn't write it this time; try again later
problem.no_list: Couldn't find a list of items in the result
problem.no_model: No Information processing model is set up
problem.not_deduped: The same result came in twice, so duplicates aren't caught
problem.not_found: The subscription or connector wasn't found
problem.push_source: Its device sends its items, so there's nothing to pull
problem.text_needs_snapshot: The result is text, so it can only be a snapshot
problem.unavailable: Subscriptions aren't ready yet. Try again in a moment
problem.write_verb: Its name says it changes something
raw.footer: Your edit is dry-run first and saved only if it passes.
raw.label: Recipe (JSON)
read_only: This device can only view subscriptions. Change them from a device with full access.
recipe.no_model: Every pull follows it; no model is called.
rules.footer: For this subscription only. Left empty, the extension's rules apply, then Settings › Inbox › Triage Rules.
rules.label: Rules
rules.placeholder: For example: mail from clients needs me; collapse notifications.
runs.footer: Only times, counts and error reasons are kept, never titles or bodies; the last 20 runs. Rounds skipped while rate-limited or not connected aren't runs.
runs.none_detail: It pulls on schedule once a destination is on.
runs.push_footer: Only times, counts and error reasons are kept, never titles or bodies; the last 20 runs. Each run is one send from Shortcuts; an item sent again isn't added twice.
setup.args_footer: You can write {{since}} (the last pull, an hour earlier; the day before for the first) or {{since_date}} (its date).
setup.dry_footer: Trying it calls this read-only tool once. The result shows only here and isn't saved.
setup.fields_footer: The choices are fields the dry run found, with an example. A title is required; without an ID, duplicates are caught by content.
setup.save_footer: It's tried once more before saving, and saved only if every check passes.
setup.snapshot_only: The result is text, so it can only be a snapshot: the whole text is kept each time it changes.
source.delete: Turn Off and Delete Stored Content
source.delete_confirm:
Turn off "{source}" and delete what it added to the Inbox and the knowledge base?

This can't be undone. To pause it instead, turn both switches off.
source.direct: This connector already adds to the Inbox or the knowledge base itself; a subscription may duplicate it.
source.inbox_detail: One row for each of the new {noun}, triaged by AI
source.kb_detail: Grouped into conversations you can search
source.min_interval: This source allows at most one pull every {span}.
source.native: Persona already reads {where} directly; subscribing would duplicate it.
source.push_how: Items come from the Handle Notification action in Shortcuts on {device}, whenever a shortcut or an automation runs it. Only what the shortcut passes is sent: nothing reads other apps' notifications.
source.rules_default: The extension's or the global rules
tier_detail.default: Items with a due date need you
tier_detail.wait: Held out of the Inbox until a model can triage it
toast.conflict: It was just changed elsewhere, so the page is refreshed.
toast.created: Saved. Turn on a destination to start pulling.
toast.deleted: Turned off, and stored content deleted.
toast.push_added: Added. Turn on a destination, then send from Shortcuts.
tools.intro: Choose a tool that gets the latest new things. Persona follows it on every pull without calling a model.
tools.no_footer: A subscription calls its tool again and again on its own, so anything doubtful is left out: the connector must mark it read-only, its maker must not mark it as changing anything, and its name must not say send, create, delete or the like.
trouble.failing_why: It waits longer after each failure (at most 6 hours) and never stops on its own. Next try {time}.
trouble.needs_recipe: The tool changed: fix the recipe
trouble.needs_recipe_why: The app's tool or its results changed, and pulling the old way would store the wrong things, so it's paused. Fix the recipe to resume.
trouble.not_connected_why: The connector is signed out or turned off. That isn't a failure; it resumes once connected.
trouble.rate_limited_why: The service asked to wait, so all subscriptions on this account wait together and resume on time.
